name: Board Game
description: The tabletop pack: seeded dice, a branching track of effect-bearing spaces, tokens that lap and capture, a chance deck, and pass-and-play turn order. The design stance is that a board game is an auditable system wearing a party's clothes — every roll is reproducible from utility.dice_roll_resolver's seed, every shuffle from the deck's, because the genre runs on contested luck and the only durable answer to 'the game cheated' is a log. Chance-deck piles deliberately compose inventory.deck_manager rather than re-deriving shuffle logic, and hidden-information handoff is treated as a first-class beat rather than an afterthought.
loop: roll/activate → move token → resolve space → pass turn

signatureCompound.name: A Full Turn Around the Board
signatureCompound.description: One complete turn that proves the loop: dice_roll_resolver rolls a seeded 2d6, token_movement walks the token that many edges and passes start for a lap payout, board_track_path resolves the landing space — a chance space, so card_draw_deck reveals a card that economy.currency acts on — then hotseat_turn_pass clears hidden state and hands the device to the next player.
